> A CDN, or content delivery network, is a global network of edge servers that cache copies of your static content close to your users.

When someone visits, the nearest edge server answers instead of your origin, so images, scripts, and pages load faster and your server does less work. It speeds up cacheable content, not dynamic or per-user responses.

CDN Explained: What a Content Delivery Network Actually Does

Quick thread 🧵
> A CDN, or content delivery network, is a global network of edge servers that cache copies of your static content close to your users.
When someone visits, the nearest edge server answers instead of your origin, so images, scripts, and pages load faster and your server does less work.
It speeds up cacheable content, not dynamic or per-user responses.
